title: [PDF] fifth-third-comerica-public-comments-2.pdf - Federal Reserve Board
summary: A public comment filed with the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland on December 8, 2025, raising concerns about the proposed merger between Fifth Third Bancorp and Comerica Inc. The commenter, unaffiliated with HoldCo, requests an extension of the public comment period, a public hearing, and delay of shareholder meetings pending resolution of a Delaware lawsuit alleging CEO self-dealing and governance failures. The comment also notes active investigations by the SEC, Treasury Department, and Senate Finance Committee.
key_points: Comment filed December 8, 2025 with Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland Vice President Bryan Huddleston regarding Fifth Third-Comerica proposed merger
Delaware/HoldCo lawsuit filed November 21, 2025 alleging self-dealing by Comerica CEO Curtis Farmer
HoldCo produced 53-page analysis (July 28, 2025), 66-page analysis (November 17, 2025), and 56-page Delaware lawsuit
Fifth Third's response to 100+ pages of HoldCo analysis consisted of only two sentences in a December 1, 2025 filing
Multiple complaints filed with SEC and Treasury; Senate Finance Committee actively investigating Fifth Third's Direct Express program involvement
Commenter requests Federal Reserve extend comment period, hold public hearing, and delay January 6, 2026 shareholder meetings
Two unnamed Comerica directors would join Fifth Third's board as part of the merger
